bridge-type.label: EyeOnWater Account Bridge
bridge-type.description: Manages connection, authentication, and discovery of meters for an EyeOnWater account

parameter.name: username
parameter.label: Username
parameter.description: The email address or username for your EyeOnWater account

parameter.name: password
parameter.label: Password
parameter.description: The password for your EyeOnWater account

parameter.name: refreshInterval
parameter.label: Refresh Interval
parameter.description: How often the bridge polls the API in minutes

parameter.name: preferNewSearch
parameter.label: Prefer New Search API
parameter.description: When enabled, uses the modern search API endpoint instead of scraping the legacy dashboard

thing-type.label: EyeOnWater Water Meter
thing-type.description: Represents a physical water meter registered with EyeOnWater

parameter.name: meterUuid
parameter.label: Meter UUID
parameter.description: The internal unique identifier (UUID) of the meter

parameter.name: meterId
parameter.label: Meter ID
parameter.description: The physical ID / Serial Number of the meter

channel-type.label: Water Reading
channel-type.description: The latest total volume consumption reading reported by the meter

channel-type.label: Leak Flow Rate
channel-type.description: The rate of active water leak, if any, detected by the meter

channel-type.label: Leak Alert
channel-type.description: Indicates whether an active leak alert has been raised by the meter

channel-type.label: Low Battery Alert
channel-type.description: Indicates whether the meter battery is low

channel-type.label: Reverse Flow Alert
channel-type.description: Indicates whether reverse water flow is detected

channel-type.label: Last Read Time
channel-type.description: The exact timestamp of the latest water meter reading
